description: Bazzite 42 with the KDE Plasma desktop. The gaming distribution: a Fedora Atomic image with GPU drivers, Steam and HDR support baked in, near-unbreakable image-based updates, and an optional Steam Deck-style console mode.

maintainer.note: Catalog-only entry: no install plugin yet. downloadUrl points at the official download portal; pin a direct ISO URL and SHA-256 checksum when the plugin is written. Secure Boot needs the Universal Blue signing key enrolled, hence no secure-boot-supported tag.
